name: Fires of U'Zhul
description: The fireball has a range of 18" and causes one Strength 4 hit. It strikes the first model in its path. Armour saves are taken as normal (ie, with -1 modifier).

name: Flight of Zimmeran
description: The wizard may immediately move anywhere within 12", including into base contact with an enemy, in which case he counts as charging. If he engages a fleeing enemy in the close combat phase he will score 1 automatic hit and then his opponent will flee again (if he survives).

name: Dread of Aramar
description: A single model within 12" of the wizard must pass a Leadership test or flee 2D6" directly away from him. If he flees, he must test at the start of each of his own movement phases and will continue to flee until he passes a test. Note that this spell does not affect Undead or any model immune to fear.

name: Silver Arrows of Arha
description: Unlike other spells, this cannot be cast whilst in hand-to-hand combat. The spell summons D6+2 arrows which the wizard can use to shoot against one enemy model. The arrows have a range of 24". Use the wizard’s own Ballistic Skill to determine whether he hits or not, but ignore movement, range and cover penalties. The arrows cause one S3 hit each.

name: Luck of Shemtek
description: The wizard may re-roll all his failed dice rolls, though the second results stand. The effect lasts until the beginning of his own next turn.

name: Sword of Rezhebel
description: The sword gives the wizard +1 Attack, +2 Strength and +2 Weapon Skill. Take a Leadership test at the beginning of each of the wizard’s own turns. If the test fails, the sword disappears.

name: Doombolt
description: The bolt of doom may be targeted at any enemy model in line of sight. The Doombolt has an 18" range and causes a Strength 5 hit. If the target model is wounded, then the next closest model within 6" is also hit on a 4+, at -1 Strength than the previous hit. The bolt will keep leaping until there are no more targets within range or until its Strength drops to a one. Each model can only be hit by a bolt once per turn. Take armour saves as normal.

name: Word of Pain
description: The spell may be cast at an enemy model within 12". The victim must re-roll all successful hand to hand or missile attacks and all to wound rolls. If the victim wishes to charge, he must pass a successful Leadership test first. Lasts until the beginning of the next Dark Elf turn.

name: Soul Stealer
description: Once successfully cast, the Sorceress must make a to hit roll against a model in base contact. If the attack hits, the opponent suffers a wound with no armour save possible. The Sorceress feeds on this life-force and adds one wound to her profile. The Sorceress can never have more than one extra wound from this spell and the extra wound is lost at the end of the battle.

name: Flamesword
description: The Sorceress may choose the hand-to-hand combat weapon of a member of her warband within 6" to be engulfed in flames. The weapon acts as normal but grants +2 Strength and ignores armour saves. The spell lasts until the Sorceress’ next shooting phase.

name: Deathspasm
description: The Deathspasm has a range of 6" and must be cast on the closest enemy model. The affected model must roll on the injury chart. If successfully cast, the casting Sorceress is immediately knocked down.

name: Witch Flight
description: The Sorceress may immediately move anywhere within 12" and may count as charging. If she engages a fleeing enemy in the close combat phase she will score 1 automatic hit and the opponent will flee again.

name: Vision of Torment
description: This spell has a range of 6" and must be cast on the closest enemy model. If the Chaos Mage is in hand-to-hand combat, he must choose his target from those in base contact with him. The affected model is immediately stunned. If the model cannot be stunned it is knocked down instead.

name: Eye of God
description:
You may use the Eye of God successfully only once per battle. Choose any single model within 6", friend or foe. Roll a D6 to see what happens to the affected model.

D6: Result
1: The wrath of the gods descends upon the target. The model is taken out of action immediately. He does not have to roll on the Serious Injury chart after the battle though.
2-5: The model gains +1 to any one of his characteristics during this battle (chosen by the player who cast the spell).
6: The model gains +1 to all of its characteristics for the duration of the battle.

name: Dark Blood
description: This attack has a range of 8" and causes D3 S5 hits. It hits the first model in its path. After using this spell the Chaos Mage must roll on the Injury table for himself to see how dangerous the wound is, though treat the out of action result as stunned instead.

name: Lure of Chaos
description: The spell has a range of 12" and must be cast on the closest enemy model. Roll a D6 and add the Chaos Mage’s Leadership to the score. Then roll a D6 and add the target’s Leadership to the score. If the Chaos Mage beats his opponent’s score he gains control of the model until the model passes a Leadership test in his own recovery phase. The model may not commit suicide, but can attack models on his own side, and will not fight warriors from the Chaos Mage’s warband. If he was engaged in hand-to-hand combat with any warriors of the Chaos Mage’s warband, they will immediately move 1" apart.

name: Wings of Darkness
description: The Chaos Mage may immediately move anywhere within 12", including into base contact with an enemy, in which case he counts as charging. If he engages a fleeing enemy, in the close combat phase he will score one automatic hit and then his opponent will flee again (if he survives).

name: Word of Pain
description: All models within 3" of the Chaos Mage, friend or foe, suffer one S3 hit. No armour saves are allowed.

name: Scry
description: For the duration of the turn one hero or henchman may re-roll D3 dice rolls and add +1 or -1 to the result.

name: Curse
description: One enemy model within 12" of the Witch must re-roll all successful dice rolls for the duration of this and their next turn.

name: Dust of the Blind
description: One enemy model within 16" of the Witch is struck instantly blind. They may not shoot, charge or run, are at half Weapon Skill and will move in a random direction at the start of their turn. The Blindness lasts until the Witch casts another spell or moves.

name: Age of Stone
description: One enemy model within 12" of the Witch will be severely debilitated and all of their characteristics are reduced by -1 for the duration of this and their next turn.

name: Warrior's Bane
description: One enemy model within 18" of the Witch will be unable to use any of their weapons as they perpetually slip from their grasp. They will be unable to shoot and count as fighting with fists in Hand-to-Hand combat. The enchantment lasts for the duration of this and their next turn.

name: Cure
description: All friendly models within 6" of the Witch have a single wound healed. In addition any stunned or knocked down models may immediately stand up.

name: Lifestealer
description: You may choose a single model within 6". The target suffers a wound (no save allowed) and the Necromancer gains an extra wound for the duration of the battle. This may take the Necromancer’s Wounds above his original maximum value. This spell will not affect the Possessed or any Undead models.

name: Re-Animation
description: One Zombie that went out of action during the last hand-to-hand combat or Shooting phase immediately returns to the battle. Place the model within 6" of the Necromancer. The model cannot be placed straight into hand-to-hand combat with an enemy model.

name: Death Vision
description: The Necromancer causes fear in his enemies for the duration of the battle.

name: Spell of Doom
description: Choose one enemy model within 12". The model must immediately roll equal to or less than his Strength on a D6 or the dead emerging from the earth will rend him with supernatural power. If he fails, you may roll on the Injury table to see what happens to the unfortunate warrior.

name: Call of Vanhel
description: A single Zombie or Dire Wolf within 6" of the Necromancer may immediately move again up to its maximum Movement distance (ie, 9" in the case of Dire Wolves). If this moves them into base contact with an enemy model, they count as charging.

name: Spell of Awakening
description:
If an enemy Hero is killed (ie, your opponent rolls 11-15 on the Serious Injury chart after the battle) then the Necromancer may raise him to fight as a Zombie in his servitude.

The dead Hero retains his characteristics and all his weapons and armour but may not use any other equipment or skills. He may no longer run, counts as a Henchman group on his own, and may not gain additional experience. This spell always succeeds. The new Zombie follows all the normal Zombie rules (immune to poison, causes fear) except for retaining his profile, weapons and armour.

name: The Hammer of Sigmar
description: The wielder gains +2 Strength in hand-to-hand combat and all hits he inflicts cause double damage (eg, 2 wounds instead of 1). The Priest must test each shooting phase he wants to use the Hammer.

name: Hearts of Steel
description: Any allied warriors within 8" of the warrior become immune to fear and all alone tests. In addition, the whole warband gains +1 to any Rout tests they have to make. The effects of this spell last until the caster is knocked down, stunned or put out of action. If cast again the effects are not cumulative, ie, the maximum bonus to Rout tests remains +1.

name: Soulfire
description: All enemy models within 4" of the servant of Sigmar suffer a Strength 3 hit. No armour saves are allowed. The servants of darkness and Chaos are especially susceptible to Sigmar’s holy power. Undead and Possessed models in range suffer a Strength 5 hit instead.

name: Shield of Faith
description: The Priest is immune to all spells. Roll at the beginning of each turn in the recovery phase. On a roll of 1 or 2 the shield disappears.

name: Healing Hand
description: Any one model within 2" of the Priest (including himself) may be healed. The warrior is restored to his full quota of Wounds. In addition, if any friendly models within 2" are stunned or knocked down, they immediately come to their senses, stand up, and continue fighting as normal.

name: Armour of Righteousness
description:
The Priest has an armour save of 2+ which replaces his normal armour save. In addition, he causes fear in his enemies and is therefore immune to fear himself.

The power of the Armour of Righteousness lasts until the beginning of the Priest’s next Shooting phase.

name: Snow Squall
description: All enemy models in Hand-to-Hand combat with the priest are at -1 to hit due to the swirling snow and winds. The spell lasts for the duration of the Hand-to-Hand combat.

name: Hammerschlag
description: Choose any model within 6": that model suffers a S4 attack from an enormous ethereal hammer, including the concussion special rule.

name: Bloodlust
description: All attacks are at S + 2, and he scores a critical hit on a 5-6. The Wolf Priest must test, by rolling the prayer's difficulty or greater on 2d6, each turn to see if the prayer remains in effect.

name: Wolf's Hunger
description: One member of the warband (priest's choice) is thrown into a Frenzy.

name: Ulric's Howl
description: For the duration of the battle, all members of the priest's warband are immune to Fear and all alone tests as they feel the presence of their god. Additionally, all Rout tests are at +1.

name: Call of Ulric
description:
The Wolf Priest lets out a cry of agony as his body re-shapes itself into that of a huge, slavering wolf with the profile M 6, WS 4, BS 0, S 4, T 4, W 1, I 5, A 2, Ld 6.

During the time that the priest is in the form of a wolf, he may do nothing but attack as a wolf: no spell-casting or weapons use. He still hates Sigmar's minions though.

In each shooting phase, the priest may choose to make a Leadership test (using the Wolf's Ld 6) to regain his human form. If he is still in wolf form at the end of the battle, he gets one last chance to return to human form. If he does not, then he remains a wolf forever! He is still a hero, and thus entitled to XP gains and attribute increases. He may only choose skills from the Speed Table, with the exception of Scale Sheer Surfaces.

name: Stag's Leap
description: The Priest of Taal may immediately move anywhere within 9" including into base contact with the enemy, in which case he counts as charging and gains a +1 Strength to his first round of attacks. If he engages a fleeing enemy, in the close combat phase he will score one automatic hit at +1 Strength and then his opponent will flee again (if he survives).

name: Blessed Ale
description: Drinking a flask of Taal-blessed ale (the priest is assumed to carry as many flasks as are needed) may heal any one model within 2" of the Priest (including himself). The warrior is restored to his full quota of Wounds. In addition, any living enemy models (not Undead or Possessed) within 2" of the Priest will lose 1 Attack during the next round of combat due to the potent fumes of the ale.

name: Bear's Paw
description: The Priest invokes the blessing of Taal on himself or a single friendly model within 6". The target receives a bonus of +2 to his Strength until the Priest’s next turn.

name: Earthshudder
description: The spell is cast on a single building within 4". Any enemy models touching the building will suffer a single S3 hit. In addition the building will collapse and any models on it will count as having fallen to the ground (for example a model falling 5" to the tabletop must pass two Initiative tests to avoid taking D3 S5 hits.) Remove the terrain feature from the board for the rest of the game.

name: Tanglefoot
description: Plants, vines and even small trees burst forth from the earth, hindering all those who attempt to move through them. Until the next shooting phase every model within 12" of the Priest, friend or foe, can only move at half its Movement, except friendly models who worship Taal (a Priest of Taal's fellow Taalites, an Ostlander warband's Jaeger and Horned Hunter Zealots).

name: Summon Squirrels
description: With this spell the Priest invokes the wrath of the Lord of Beasts, summoning forth dozens upon dozens of enraged squirrels. The furious rodents assault one enemy within 12" of the Priest, crawling inside the warrior’s clothing and armour, pelting him with nuts and causing numerous tiny bites and welts. The target suffers 2D6 Strength 1 hits. No armour saves allowed.

name: Wind of Gork
description: Range: 12". The first model in its path must roll under its Toughness or take a Strength 2 hit and be knocked down automatically.

name: Gaze of Mork
description: Range: 12". D3 Strength 3 hits strike the first model in their path.

name: 'Eadbanger
description: Range: 6". Fire bolts equal to the number of the Shaman’s Base Attacks. Resolve with Strength equal to the Shaman’s Toughness at the first model in their path. After the bolts effects are resolved, roll a die. On a 1 the Shaman has drawn upon too much power, they collapse and goes Out of Action.

name: Leap of Waaagh!
description: The Shaman or any other Goblin within 3" may be moved up to 12", ignoring terrain. If this move brings them into close combat, they count as charging in the close combat phase.

name: Idol of Gork
description: The Shaman gains +1 WS, +1 S, and +1 A. This enhancement lasts until the Shaman takes a wound.

name: 'Ere we go!
description: All friendly models within 6" of the Shaman treat stunned results on the Injury Table as knocked down instead. The effects last until the Shaman takes a wound.

name: Led'z go
description: Any Orc or Goblin within 4" of the Shaman will automatically strike first in hand-to-hand combat regardless of other circumstances. The spell only lasts until the caster is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action.

name: Oi! Gerroff!
description: Range 8". Moves any enemy model within range D6" directly away from the Shaman. If the target collides with another model or a building, both suffer 1 S3 hit. May not be cast on models in hand-to-hand combat.

name: Zzap!
description: Range 12". Causes D3 S4 hits on the closest enemy target, with no armour saves allowed.

name: Fooled Ya!
description: No enemy may charge the Shaman during their next turn. If the Shaman is engaged in hand-to-hand combat he may immediately move 4" away.

name: Clubba
description: The ectoplasmic club counts as a normal club with +2 Strength bonus and gives the Shaman +1 attack as well. This spell lasts until the Shaman suffers a wound.

name: Fire of Gork
description: Range 12". Each of the two bolts causes D3 S3 hits; the bolts can either be fired both at the closest enemy target or split between the two closest enemy targets.

name: Riding the Wind
description: This spell is cast at the beginning of the caster’s Movement phase. The caster may move up to 12+D6" anywhere on the battlefield, ignoring any intervening terrain; this counts as the caster’s movement for that turn. This spell may not be used to move the caster into base contact with an enemy warrior, but the caster may shoot as normal (with a -1 penalty for having moved).

name: Skin of Stone
description: This spell may be cast on any friendly warrior within 6". The target gains +2 to his armour save but suffers a -1 penalty to Initiative. The spell may be maintained each turn, providing the affected warrior remains within 6" of the caster and the caster can pass a Difficulty test. If the caster is more than 6" away from the affected warrior in the Recovery phase, the spell cannot be maintained and wears off. Only one warrior may be affected by a Stone Skin spell at any one time, although the caster is free to cast other spells while maintaining the Stone Skin.

name: Burning Hand
description: This spell is cast at the beginning of the Combat phase. The caster may sacrifice all of his normal attacks to make one hand-to-hand attack at Strength 5, causing 2 wounds. If the enemy warrior is successfully hit, he is set on fire on a roll of 4+. This spell lasts for one round only.

name: Quicksand
description: This spell is cast at any warrior within 6". The water floods the area for 3" around the targeted warrior. The effect lasts until the beginning of the caster’s next Recovery phase. All warriors within the quicksand must pass a Strength test or be unable to move. Warriors in combat cannot attack but may defend themselves.

name: Storm of Magic
description: The caster may target any warrior within 12". If the spell is successfully cast, the target is struck by a bolt of energy and takes one S5 hit. Armour saves may be taken as normal.

name: Blessing of the Elements
description: In the post-battle sequence, the player may re-roll any one dice or modify one dice by +1/-1. If the caster was taken out of action, this spell may not be cast.

name: Divination of Shirath
description: The Mage may re-roll all his failed dice rolls, though the second result stands. The effect lasts until the beginning of the Mage’s next turn.

name: Shimmering Shield
description: This spell acts as a shield to protect the Mage. It gives him an additional unmodified 5+ save against all attacks. The effect lasts until the beginning of the Mage’s next turn.

name: Statue of Light
description: The Mage chooses a single enemy model he can see. That model may not move as long as the Mage remains both static and alive. The Mage and the target may cast spells normally, but fight in close combat at -2 WS (minimum of 1).

name: Fleeting Shadows
description: The first time the Mage is hit in close combat or shooting, the spell protects him and the hit is ignored. Move the Mage 2" from his current position in a random direction (but not off a cliff, etc). This is where he really was all along. The spell remains in play until it saves the Mage from a hit, whereupon it is dispelled. It may not be cast again whilst it is in play.

name: Hunter's Fury
description: The spell summons D3+1 arrows which the Mage can use to shoot against one enemy model following the rules for normal shooting. The arrows have a range of 36". Use the Mage’s own Ballistic Skill to determine whether he hits or not, but ignore movement, range and cover penalties. Each arrow causes one S3 hit.

name: Silent Guardian
description: This spell acts as an invisible guardian that will defend the Mage. If the Mage is attacked in close combat then the guardian will fight first with WS5, S3. The guardian will make 1 attack per turn against each enemy that attacks the Mage. The guardian will not leave the Mage’s side, and will only fight if the Mage himself is being attacked. The Guardian cannot be attacked in return and will only be dispelled if the Mage casts another spell or dies.

name: Singing Wind
description: The goddess appears in the form of singing motes and dancing lights that will entrance and ‘hold’ any model within 10" until the start of the Amazon player’s next turn. The model cannot move, shoot, or cast spells, but may defend itself in hand-to-hand combat. Models affected by this ritual automatically go last in combat.

name: Serpent's Strength
description: All friendly models close to the Priestess will be charged with a frantic energy until the end of their next turn. During this time any model within 8" of the Priestess (including herself) will add +1 to their Strength. The ritual cannot be cast if the Priestess is in close combat during her Shooting phase. The effects will continue after the ritual is cast if the Priestess enters combat.

name: Wendala's Maelstrom
description: The storm extends out from the Priestess 18". All attempts to shoot missile weapons by the enemy will be at -1 to hit. The ritual lasts up until the start of the Amazon player’s next turn.

name: Shield of Thorns
description: The ritual produces a cocoon of thorns all about the Priestess, making her immune to ranged or magical attacks. Any models wishing to charge the Priestess can do so but the thorns negate any strikes by the Priestess and her enemies in the first round of combat. The Priestess cannot cast this ritual while in hand-to-hand combat.

name: The Living Jungle
description: Pick one model within 12". The model is suddenly swarmed by a savage mix of snakes, spiders and insects, most of them poisonous. The afflicted model takes 1D6 Strength 2 hits with no armour saves allowed apart from Ward saves. You cannot use a dodge save against a swarm.

name: Siren's Dreams
description: The song is so beautiful and mesmerising that it momentarily distracts the Amazon’s enemies within 12" such that all Ld tests for the opposing warband are made at -1 until the end of the opposing player’s next turn. Lizardmen and Undead are immune to the effects of this ritual.

name: Spectre of Hashut
description: Designate the enemy miniature closest to the wizard’s miniature within 10”. That miniature is automatically stunned.

name: Stone Statue
description: Choose an enemy miniature that is within 12” of you and is in your line of sight. For the rest of the turn and the following turn, the miniature will not be able to do anything. If attacked in melee, the miniature will suffer an automatic hit. If it is shot, the miniature that shoots at it will get a +1 bonus on hit.

name: Fireball
description: This spell has a range of 16” and requires line of sight. The target receives an automatic hit of strength 4.

name: Vanish
description: The wizard may immediately make a move of up to 6” in any direction and may enter or leave combat without penalty. If he enters combat, he is considered to be making a charge move.

name: Eruption
description: All miniatures within a distance of up to 4” (friend or foe) suffer an automatic hit of Strength 4. After resolving the effects of this hit, the sorcerer will not be able to cast any more spells until the next turn and will suffer a -1 to his Toughness attribute.

name: Eye of Hashut
description:
Choose a friendly miniature within 12” and roll 1D6. Hobgoblins always subtract 1 from the result.

You may use the Eye of Hashut successfully only once per battle.

1D6: Result
1: Hashut does not trust you. The miniature is immediately out of action, although it will not roll on the serious injury table during the post-battle sequence.
2-5: Hashut trusts you. The miniature adds +1 to one of its attributes for the rest of the game.
6: Hashut favors you. The miniature adds +1 to all attributes for the rest of the game.

name: Wind of Gork
description: A blast of foul flatulence signals Gork’s wrath. Range: 12". The first model in its path must roll under its Toughness or take a S2 hit and be knocked down automatically.

name: Gaze of Mork
description: Range 12". D3 S3 hits strike the first model in their path.

name: 'Eadbanger
description: Range 6". Fire bolts equal to the number of the Shaman’s Attacks. Resolve with Strength equal to the Shaman’s Toughness at the first model in their path. After the bolts effects are resolved, roll a die. On a 1 the Shaman has drawn upon too much power. The Shaman collapses and goes out of action.

name: Leap of Waaagh!
description: The Shaman or any other Goblin within 3" may be moved up to 12". If this move brings them into close combat, they count as charging in the close combat phase.

name: Idol of Gork
description: The Shaman gains +1 WS, +1 S, and +1 A. This enhancement lasts until the Shaman takes a wound.

name: 'Ere we go
description: All friendly models within 6" of the Shaman treat stunned results on the injury table as knocked down instead. The effects last until the Shaman takes a wound.

name: Morr's Protection
description: Any Magical attacks made by a Necromancer, a Magister or Daemons, which would be considered a direct attack on the priest, will be negated if this rite is successful.

name: Death Holds No Fear
description: The priest of Morr is now Fearless for the remainder of the game.

name: Sanctity of the Fallen
description: The priest of Morr may attempt to perform the Rite of Sanctity on a model (friend or foe) who has been taken Out of Action. The priest of Morr must be within 6” of the model in question. If successful, the model may not be raised up by a Necromancer.

name: Hand of Morr
description: The priest of Morr must be in base-to-base contact with an Undead model. Before Hand-to-Hand combat occurs, the priest of Morr may attempt to use the Hand of Morr rite. If successful the foe immediately goes out of action (this affects Zombies, Dire Wolves and Vampires). Ghouls and Possessed affected by this rite will immediately flee their full Move away from the priest of Morr.

name: Do you know who I am?
description: This rite has a range of 6” and must be directed at the closest Undead model first, or if no Undead are within range, at the next closest human servant of the Undead (Dregs, Ghouls, Necromancers), or finally at any model. If successful, that model is immediately Stunned. If the model cannot be Stunned, then it is Knocked Down instead.

name: I am death!
description: This spell gives the priest of Morr a 6+ armour save and increases their WS by either +1 or makes it 4, whichever is greater.

name: Lady's Favors
description: All your heroes count as having Lucky Charms for this battle and ignore the first hit against them on a D6 roll of 4+. If they already own Lucky Charms, they may reroll a failed Lucky Charm save, accepting the second result.

name: Blessed Protection
description: The Damsel and any Bretonnians within 6" of her gain an unmodified ward save of 4+ against the effects of spells or prayers. Test each shooting phase: on a roll of 1 or 2, the spell dissipates.

name: Swiftstride
description: The damsel may pick a friendly hero or henchman (including herself) within 12” that charged or failed a charge this turn. That warrior gains +1 to hit on all attacks they make until the end of the turn. In addition, if they are not in combat, they may make an additional move of 1D6” towards an enemy (if they move into base contact with an enemy, this counts as a charge).

name: Lady's Scorn
description: Anyone attempting to shoot at the Damsel must first pass a Leadership test, or else they are unable to fire this turn. This includes Silver Arrows, Crossbow Pistols, Hand-to-Hand Pistols, and Template shot weapons that she is within the path of (like Blunderbusses.) This spell lasts until the end of the game.

name: Elixir of Life
description: Any one model within 4” of the Damsel (including herself) may be healed. The warrior is restored to his full quota of Wounds. In addition, if any friendly models within 4” are stunned or knocked down, they immediately come to their senses, stand up, and continue fighting as normal.

name: Guiding Vision
description: The Damsel picks a friendly hero or henchman within 8”. Until the start of your next shooting phase, that warrior may re-roll one die roll they make and add +1 or -1 to the result.

name: Chotec's Wrath
description: A lightning bolt shoots from the sky above and strikes the closest enemy model within 10" of the Skink Priest, causing a single Strength 5 hit. However add +1 to the Strength and +1 to the roll on the injury table if the model is wearing armour like light armour, heavy armour, Ithilmar armour or Gromril armour.

name: Sotec's Blessing
description:
This spell may be cast on a single model within 6" of the Skink Priest or on himself. Roll a D6 to determine the blessing. The effects remain in play until the Priest or the model is Stunned or taken Out of Action. Only a single model may be affected by the blessing at any given time.

D6: Effect
1-2: +1 BS or +1 to hit in close combat.
3-4: Toughness +1.
5-6: Movement and Initiative +1.

name: Huanchi's Stealth
description: The spell affects all Skinks within 6" of the Skink Priest, including himself, and allows any model that is in cover to immediately go into hiding. A model may go into hiding even if they ran in the movement phase or has already shot with a missile weapon.

name: The Old Ones' Protection
description: The Skink Priest and any Lizardmen within 4" of him gain a save of 4+ against the effects of spells or prayers. This spell remains in play until the Skink Priest is taken Out of Action.

name: Tinci's Rage
description: A single Lizardman within 6" of the Skink Priest or himself, is overtaken by rage and follows the rules for Frenzy, in addition he gains +1 Strength. This spell remains in play until the Skink Priest or the model is stunned or is taken out of action. At the beginning of the turn the Skink priest must pass a Leadership roll in order to keep the spell going. Only a single model may be affected by the blessing at any given time, but the Skink Priest can choose to release the spell at the beginning of his turn if he wishes to attempt to recast it on another model later in the shooting phase.

name: Itzl's Speed
description: A single Lizardman model within 6" of the Skink Priest or himself, may make an additional sprint of movement and move up to 4". This counts, as running and a model may not move if he has already fired with a missile weapon. He may not charge with this extra move.

name: Bolt of Dark Light
description: The bolt has a range of 12" and causes a single Strength 5 hit against the first model in its path.

name: Betrayal in Death
description: This spell will affect all enemy models slain in the shooting phase or close combat and lasts until the start of the caster's next turn. The enemies will reanimate as they are killed and attack their comrades. If not in combat the model will shoot if able, or charge if it has no missile weapons. If in combat the enemy will only make a single attack. After attacking the enemy will fall once more, dead.

name: Nightmare
description: This spell may be cast upon an enemy model within 18" of the caster. The model must take an immediate fear test as if charged by a fear-causing enemy. If failed the model flees 2D6" away from the Dark Emissary.

name: Curse of the Dark Master
description: This spell can be cast upon a single model within 24" of the caster. All that model's rolls to hit for both shooting and combat are reduced by -1 until the start of the caster's next turn.

name: Fog of Death
description: This spell affects every model on the board except the Dark Emissary. Enemy models are affected on a roll of 4+, while friendly models are only affected on a 6+. All models attacked by the nightmare creatures suffer a strength 2 hit. The fog lasts until the start of the caster's next turn and reduces line of sight to 3D6" for all warriors present which will affect shooting, charging etc.

name: Coils of the Serpent
description: This spell may be cast upon a single enemy model within 6" of the caster. The model must take an immediate toughness test to fight off the deadly serpent. If failed the model is crushed to death and out of action. No saves of any kind will protect against this magic.

name: Wings of Fate
description: The flock has a range of 18" and may attack any model within this range of the Truthsayer. The enemy model suffers D3 Strength 2 hits.

name: Light of Battle
description: This spell may be cast upon a friendly model within 12" of the caster. That model has an additional save of 5+ that can be reduced in any way against all attacks until the start of the Truthsayer's next turn.

name: Gift of Life
description: This spell may be cast upon a friendly model slain in the previous enemy turn. The model is immediately restored back to 1 wound remaining and should be placed as accurately as possible where they fell.

name: Blessing of Valour
description: This spell may be cast upon a single friendly model within 24". The model is infused with strength and courage, gaining +1 to all hit rolls in close combat for the duration of the turn.

name: Boon of Courage
description: This spell affects all friendly models within 12". The models are completely immune to the effects of psychology and all alone tests until the end of the Truthsayer's next turn.

name: Voice of Command
description: This spell affects one model within 24" of the Truthsayer. That model may do nothing in its next turn other than defend itself in combat. It may not move, shoot, attack or perform any other action.

name: Warpfire
description: The spell has a range of 8", hitting the first model in its path. The spell causes D3 Strength 4 hits on its target, and one Strength 3 hit on each model within 2" of the target.

name: Children of the Horned Rat
description: This spell must be used before the game, and may only be used once. When cast, the spell summons D3 Giant Rats, which are placed within 6" of the Sorcerer. The Sorcerer may cast this spell successfully only once per battle, and the rats disappear after the battle. They do not count towards the maximum size of the Skaven warband.

name: Gnawdoom
description: The Gnawdoom causes 2D6 Strength 1 hits on a single model within 8" of the caster.

name: Black Fury
description: The Sorcerer may immediately charge any enemy model within 12" (ignoring any terrain and interposing models) and gains 2 extra Attacks and +1 Strength during this turn’s hand-to-hand combat phase only.

name: Eye of the Warp
description: All standing models in base contact with the Sorcerer must take an immediate Leadership test. If they fail, they each suffer a Strength 3 hit and must run 2D6" directly away from the Sorcerer, exactly as if they had lost their nerve when fighting against more than one opponent.

name: Sorcerer's Curse
description: The spell has a range of 12" and affects a single model within range. The target must re-roll any successful armour saves and to hit rolls during the Skaven hand-to-hand phase and his own next shooting and hand-to-hand combat phases.

name: Menkare's Scroll of Urgency
description: A single Skeleton Soldier within 6" may immediately move again up to its maximum Movement distance, ie 4". If this takes the model into base contact with an enemy model, it counts as charging.

name: Horrebe's Curse of the Mummy
description: The target must be in base-to-base contact with a Mummy and within 18" of the Liche Priest. If the spell is cast successfully, the enemy model has a -1 penalty on all to hit and to wound rolls, and on all armour saves. This lasts until the start of the next Tomb Guardian Shooting phase.

name: Tawosret's Scroll of Tomb Dust
description: A single warrior within 12" is automatically knocked down as he chokes on the sand. This spell only affects a living model.

name: Neferre's Scroll of Quaking Horror
description: A warrior within 12" must pass a Leadership test or flee 2D6" directly away from the Liche Priest. The warrior will continue to flee in each Movement phase until he makes a successful Rally test in the Recovery phase. This spell has no effect on Undead models or models that are immune to psychology.

name: Merneptah's Scroll of the Scarab Song
description: A single model within 8" of the Liche Priest suffers 2D6 Strength 1 hits. In addition, that model may not be shot at for the rest of the Tomb Guards shooting phase, nor may he fight or be fought in hand-to-hand combat. If the model is already in hand-to-hand combat, move him 1" away from the combat as he staggers about in agony. Unless he suffers an actual injury the warrior counts as having just stood up in the next turn.

name: Djedre's Summonation of the Vengeful Dead
description: The Liche Priest may re-animate a Skeleton Soldier that went out of action during the last turn. Place the model anywhere within 6" of the Liche Priest, but not straight into hand-to-hand combat with an enemy model.

name: Menkare's Scroll of Urgency
description: A single Skeleton Soldier within 6" may immediately move again up to its maximum Movement distance, ie 4". If this takes the model into base contact with a model, it counts as charging.

name: Horrebe's Curse of the Mummy
description: A single model within 18" of the Liche Priest that is in hand-to-hand combat with a Mummy has -1 to hit, -1 to wound and -1 on armour save rolls. This lasts until the start of the next Tomb Guardian shooting phase.

name: Tawosret's Scroll of Tomb Dust
description: A single warrior within 12" is automatically knocked down as he chokes on the sand. This spell only affects a living model.

name: Neferre's Scroll of Quaking Horror
description: A warrior within 12" must pass a Leadership test or flee 2D6" directly away from the Liche Priest. He continues to flee in each Movement phase until he passes a Rally test in the Recovery phase. This spell has no effect on Undead models or models that are immune to psychology.

name: Merneptah's Scroll of the Scarab Song
description: A single model within 12" of the Liche Priest suffers 1D6 Strength 1 hits. In addition, that model may not be shot at for the rest of the Tomb Guard's shooting phase, nor may he fight or be fought in hand-to-hand combat. If the model is already in hand-to-hand combat, move him 1" away from the combat. The model may be attacked and attack as normal in his next turn.

name: Djedre's Summonation of the Vengeful Dead
description: The Liche Priest may return a Skeleton Soldier that went out of action to the battle. Place the model within 6" of the Liche Priest.

name: Spell of Awakening
description:
If an enemy Hero is killed (i.e. your opponent rolls 11-15 on the serious injury chart after the battle), then the sorcerer may raise him to fight as a Zombie in his servitude.

The dead Hero retains his characteristics and all his weapons and armour but may not use any equipment or skills. He may no longer run, counts as a Henchmen group on his own and does not gain additional experience.

name: Lifestealer
description: Choose a single model within 6”. The target suffers a wound, (no saves allowed) and the sorcerer gains an extra wound for the duration of the battle. This may take the Wounds of a Necromancer above their original maximum value, but a Liche may only restore lost wounds. This spell will not affect the Possessed or any Undead models.

name: Reanimation
description: One Zombie that went out of action during the last hand to hand combat phase immediately returns to battle. Place the model within 6” of the sorcerer. The model cannot be placed straight into hand to hand combat with an enemy model. This spell can be used on Grave Guards and Wights to restore 1 lost wound (should they have more than one). This cannot be used to bring Scarecrows, Grave Guards, Wights and Skeletons back to life if they are taken out of action the way Zombies can.

name: Spell of Doom
description: Choose one enemy model within 12”. The model must immediately roll equal to or less than his Strength on a D6 or the dead emerging from the earth will rend him with supernatural power. If he fails, you may roll on the Injury table to see what happens to the unfortunate warrior.

name: Call of Vanhel
description: A single Zombie, Skeleton, Wight or Grave Guard within 6” of the caster may immediately move again up to its maximum movement distance. If this moves them into base contact with an enemy model then it counts as charging. The targeted Zombie, Skeleton, Wight or Grave Guard will automatically pass Initiative tests needed to be made during this extra movement.

name: Deathly Visage
description: Necromancers only. The Necromancer causes fear in his enemies for the duration of the battle and is likewise immune to fear. This spell is the one exception to the Apprentices rule that Necromancers must usually follow in a Liche warband: a Necromancer may choose this spell if the Liche has the spell Horror.

name: Living Horror
description: Liche only. Choose one model within 8" of the Liche and roll D6+3. If the score is equal to or greater than the Leadership of the target model, it suffers a Wound, no armour saves allowed. If this wounds the target and it still has Wounds remaining, it may not move, shoot or cast spells during its next turn unless it passes a Leadership test. This spell will not affect the Possessed, Undead, or any model that is immune to fear.

name: Howl of the North
description: The Shaman is immune to all missile fire. Roll a dice during the Shaman’s recovery phase. On a roll of 1 or 2 the winds dissipate.

name: Angvar's Fury
description: All warriors within 8" of the Shaman gain a +1 to hit in hand-to-hand combat against the opposing warband. The spell lasts till the start of the Norse players next turn.

name: Elvek's Cold Spear
description: The icicle has a range of 18" and causes one S4 hit. It strikes the first model in its path. Normal armour saves apply.

name: Gift of the Fates
description: The Shaman may adjust one die roll by +1/–1 between a successful casting of this rune and his next recovery phase. A ‘to wound’ roll adjusted to or from 6 will not cause a critical.

name: Kiss of Frost
description: A single model within 12" of the Shaman must pass an Initiative test or be knocked down.

name: Bear's Might
description: The Shaman gains +1 Attack, +2 Strength, +2 Toughness and loses -2 Initiative (to a minimum of 1). Take a Leadership test at the beginning of each turn (both yours and your opponent’s). If the test fails, Bear’s Might drains away. Bear’s Might can only be cast successfully once per game.

name: Daemonic Vigour
description: Any Plague Bearers or Nurglings within 8" of the Master increase their Daemonic Aura save from 5+ to 4+ until the beginning of their next turn.

name: Buboes
description: This spell has a range of 8" and affects a single enemy warrior. The warrior must pass a Toughness test or lose a Wound. No Armour saves are allowed.

name: Stench of Nurgle
description: This spell has a range of 6" and affects all living creatures – friend or foe. Each enemy warrior in range must pass a Toughness test or lose an Attack until their next turn.

name: Pestilence
description: All enemy models within 12" of the Master suffer a Strength 3 hit. No Armour saves are allowed.

name: Scabrous Hide
description: The Master has an armour save of 2+ which replaces any normal Armour save. The Scabrous Hide lasts until the beginning of his next Shooting phase.

name: Nurgle's Rot
description: All enemy models in base contact with the Master must immediately test against their Toughness or contract Nurgle’s Rot.

name: Touch of Onogal
description: This spell can be used against one of the Seer’s close combat opponents. If he takes the model out of action in the following hand-to-hand combat phase, that player rolls for Serious Injuries immediately. If the model dies permanently, replace it with a Nurgle Plague Bearer (see Bestiary for rules) for the rest of the game under the Seer’s control. If the Seer is stunned or taken out of action the Plague Bearer disappears into the Realm of Chaos. Note that only one Plague Bearer can be created at a time.

name: Buboes
description: This spell has a range of 8" and affects a single enemy warrior. The warrior must pass a Toughness test or lose a Wound. No Armour saves are allowed.

name: Stench of Nurgle
description: This spell has a range of 6" and affects all living creatures – friend or foe. Each enemy warrior in range must pass a Toughness test or lose an Attack until their next turn.

name: Pestilence
description: All enemy models within 12" of the caster suffer a Strength 3 hit. No Armour saves are allowed.

name: Scabrous Hide
description: The caster has an armour save of 2+ which replaces any normal Armour save. The Scabrous Hide lasts until the beginning of his next Shooting phase.

name: Nurgle's Rot
description: All enemy models in base contact with the caster must immediately test against their Toughness or contract Nurgle’s Rot, the Blessing of Nurgle of that name.

name: Sacrificial Ritual
description: The Chaos Dwarf Sorcerer must be in contact with an Engine of Chaos in order to successfully cast this spell. As the ritual requires the sacrifice of a mortal, remove one captive model from the Engine of Chaos and its starting warband’s roster. The Sorcerer may sacrifice additional captives to lower the spell's difficulty by –1 per sacrifice. These models must be sacrificed before rolling for Difficulty. The Chaos Dwarf Sorcerer gains +D3 Experience.

name: Spirit of Hashut
description: The player draws a line 18” from the Sorcerer. All models crossed by the line, suffer one S4 hit.

name: Bellow of Doom
description: All models engaged in base contact with the sorcerer must make an immediate Ld test or break from combat and run.

name: Fumes of Azgorh
description: The spell has a range of 8", hitting all models in its path on a D6 score of 4+. Any model hit suffers a S4 hit, roll to wound as normal. No armour saves allowed.

name: Flickering Hide
description: The Sorcerer may cast this spell upon himself or any one model within 6”. The flaming hide will negate any one wound suffered on a D6 roll of 4+. In hand-to-hand combat, any model which hits the flaming hide will suffer one S3 hit for each hit scored. The Flaming Hide lasts until the beginning of the Sorcerer’s next shooting phase.

name: Lava Flow
description: The Sorcerer may move 12” in any direction, even into combat, counting as a charge. However, due to the nature of this spell the Sorcerer may only reappear on or below the ground.

name: Earthquake
description: All models within 3” of the Sorcerer, friend or foe alike, must roll equal to or under their Initiative or suffer D3 S4 hits.

name: Pool of Shadow
description:
The spell fills the area around the mage with twisting shadows. The mage and all models within 6" may Hide as if there were a wall or obstruction between them and their enemies. They may Hide even after marching.

If an enemy enters the area the effect is disrupted. While the spell lasts all affected models count as being in cover against enemy shooting. The spell lasts until the start of the Shadow Weaver’s next turn.

name: The Living Shadows
description: The Shadow Weaver may cast this spell at any enemy model within 12" and within 2" of a wall. The target suffers a single Strength 4 hit with no armour saves.

name: Wings of Night
description:
This spell may only be cast if the Shadow Weaver is within 2" of a wall. He is instantly moved up to 12" to a position that is also within 2" of a wall.

If the move places him into base contact with an enemy model he counts as charging in the first round of combat.

name: Cloak of Darkness
description:
The Shadow Weaver is concealed from enemy sight. As long as he does not attack enemy models (cast spells, shoot, or fight in close combat) he may not be attacked.

He may intercept as normal if desired, but he is not required to do so. If he does not intercept, enemies may charge past him. The spell lasts until the Shadow Weaver attacks an enemy model.

A model engaged in close combat may never choose not to attack.

name: Shadowbind
description:
The Shadow Weaver may cast this spell at any enemy model within 24" and within 2" of a wall.

The target may not move unless it first passes a Strength test on 1D6+1 at the start of its turn before the Recovery phase.

The spell lasts until the Shadow Weaver suffers a wound or attempts to cast another spell. If the affected model is attacked, treat it exactly as if it were Stunned.

name: Shield of Shadow
description:
The Shadow Weaver may cast this spell on himself or a member of his warband within 12".

The target gains a 5+ armour save that is not modified by the attacker’s Strength. The spell lasts until the start of the Shadow Weaver’s next turn.

name: Delicious Suffering
description: All models (friend and foe, except the Seer) within 3" must pass a Ld test or are knocked down.

name: Dance of the Serpent
description:
All enemy models that are not immune to psychology suffer a –1 ‘to hit’ against him in close combat.

The Dance lasts until the beginning of the Seer’s next shooting phase.

name: Endless Torment
description: Choose one enemy model within 8”. From now on the model must roll for injury –1 after its Recovery phase. For the duration of the Torment the Seer can do nothing else but end the spell at the beginning of his turn and if attacked in close combat, he is hit automatically and the spell breaks.

name: Mystify
description: Target enemy model within 8" will have their Initiative value reduced to 1 and will always strike last in close combat, even if they charge an opponent or are armed with a spear or pike and are charged themselves. This spell lasts until the target passes a Ld test during the recovery phase.

name: A Thousand Voices
description:
Choose one enemy model within 12”. For the duration of the spell the model reduces its Ld by D3 +1 (to a minimum of 2) if it is not immune to psychology.

The model must pass a Ld test at the beginning of its turn to end the spell. The spell breaks also when the Seer loses a wound. A thousand Voices can only enchant one model at a time.

name: Shornaal's Temptation
description: Choose one enemy model within 8” that is not immune to psychology. The model must pass a Ld test. If the model fails, then the Seer gains control over the model. The player may attempt to regain control at the beginning of his turn by passing a Ld test. Shornaal's Temptation can only enchant one model at a time. If the Seer is hit whether by a missile or in close combat he must pass a Ld test or the spell ends.

name: Tchar's Blessing
description: This spell must be used before the game and may only be used once. The Seer may not cast spells in the following battle. After the game he gains D3 Experience points if he wasn’t taken out of action.

name: Dispel Magic
description: The Seer ends all effects of currently active spells.

name: Foresight
description: This spell must be used before the game and may only be used once. Choose a warband. One randomly determined Hero of that warband must miss the following game. Models that are capable of casting spells or prayers are immune to this effect.

name: Wrath of the Great Eagle
description: Choose one enemy model within 12”. The model is hit with a Strength equal to the difference of the Seer’s Experience points and the model’s Experience (to a maximum of 10). Armour saves are taken as normal. If the victim has more Experience points than the Seer, the latter is hit instead.

name: Tchar's Reward
description:
The Seer gets +1 on any one stat per 10 Experience points he has. Each stat may be increased only once through this spell.

The power of Tchar’s Reward lasts until the end of the Seer’s next shooting phase and can be re-cast in that phase.

name: Slave to Chaos
description: This spell has a range of 12” and causes one Strength 2 hit with no armour save. If the model is taken out of action roll for Serious Injuries immediately. If they die replace the killed warrior with a Horror of Tzeentch (see Bestiary for rules) until the end of the game. If the Seer is stunned or taken out of action the Horror disappears into the Realm of Chaos.

name: Life Seed
description: One enemy model within 6" takes a S4 hit. If it is wounded or taken out of action, the Damsel gains +1 wound for the rest of the battle; the extra wound goes after the battle.

name: Grail Fervor
description: A friendly model within 8" gains +1 Strength and a zealous rage, until the Damsel or that model is stunned or taken out of action. The Damsel must pass a Leadership test at the start of each of her turns to keep it.

name: Veil of the Fey
description: A mist surrounds the Damsel: she can't be charged, and if she casts it while in combat with an enemy she may teleport up to 4". Roll again at the start of each shooting phase to keep it.

name: Healing Aura
description: Every friendly model within 6" of the Damsel may take a free recovery phase. A model with several wounds that isn't stunned or knocked down may recover +1 wound.

name: Wrath of the Lady
description: One enemy model within 12" takes 1D3 S4 hits that ignore armour saves.

name: Fredemund's Flock
description: Pick a point within 8" of the Damsel: every enemy model within 3" of it takes a S3 hit.

name: Doombolt
description: An 18" bolt at any enemy model in line of sight: a S5 hit. If it wounds, the next closest model within 6" is hit on a 4+ at -1 Strength from the last hit, up to four leaps or until no target is in range. No model is hit twice by one casting; armour saves as normal.

name: Word of Pain
description: One enemy model within 12" must re-roll every successful hit, in close combat or shooting, and every successful roll to wound, and must pass a Leadership test to charge. Lasts until the start of the next Dark Elf turn.

name: Soul Stealer
description: In the close combat phase the Sorceress must score at least one hit on a model in base contact: it suffers a wound with no armour save and she gains a wound. She can never have more than one extra wound from it (she may cast it again to regain lost wounds), and it goes after the battle.

name: Black Blade of Khaine
description: The close combat weapon of a warrior of her warband within 6" burns with black flame: +2 to the user's Strength, and its hits ignore armour saves. Lasts until the Sorceress's shooting phase.

name: Deathspasm
description: Cast on the closest enemy model within 6": it rolls on the injury chart. Once it is cast the Sorceress is knocked down at once, and Jump Up can't stop it.

name: Witch Flight
description: The Sorceress moves anywhere within 12" at once and may count as charging. Engaging a fleeing enemy in the close combat phase, she scores 1 automatic hit and the enemy flees again.

name: Scry
description: For the rest of the turn one hero or henchman may re-roll D3 dice and change each result by +1 or -1.

name: Curse
description: One enemy model within 12" of the Seer must re-roll every successful dice roll this turn and its next.

name: Dust of the Blind
description: One enemy model within 16" is blinded: it can't shoot, charge or run, its Weapon Skill is halved and it moves in a random direction at the start of its turn. Lasts until the Seer casts another spell or moves.

name: Age of Stone
description: One enemy model within 12" has -1 to every characteristic this turn and its next.

name: Warrior's Bane
description: One enemy model within 18" can't use its weapons this turn and its next: it can't shoot and fights with its fists in hand-to-hand combat.

name: Cure of Thorns
description: Knocked down or stunned friendly models within 6" of the Seer stand up at once, each passing its state to an enemy model within 6", which is knocked down or stunned in its place: one enemy for each friend. With no enemy in range the Seer may take the injury on herself, so that one model stands. A model that stood up may cast spells or shoot, but not charge or run.

name: Fires of Strigos
description: An 18" fireball: one S4 hit on the first model in its path, armour saves as normal (at -1).

name: Winged Flight
description: The Vampire moves anywhere within 18" at once, into base contact with an enemy too, when he counts as charging. Engaging a fleeing enemy in the close combat phase, he scores 1 automatic hit and the enemy flees again.

name: Lifestealer
description: One model within 6" suffers a wound with no save, and the Vampire gains a wound for the battle, even above his starting Wounds. No effect on the Possessed. Cast on another Vampire, its Difficulty is 1 higher.

name: Song of Thorns
description: One enemy model within 8" takes 2D6 S1 hits.

name: Murmuring of the Wind
description: The caster may move anywhere within 12". If he reaches hand-to-hand combat, it counts as a charge.

name: The Rain Song
description: Every model within 6" of the caster, Wood Elves excepted, has -1 to hit and -1 Initiative until the start of the caster's next magic phase.

name: Lyrics of Feral Infatuation
description: An animal or monster must pass a Leadership test on its own Leadership to attack. One that fails does nothing else that turn, not even fight back if attacked.

name: Song of the Sun
description: One model within 18" has -1 Movement until the caster's next magic phase, and must make a test: if it fails, it takes a S4 hit.

name: Eagle's Cry
description: Every Wood Elf within 6" of the caster has +1 to hit and +1 on the Critical Hit tables until the start of the caster's next magic phase.

name: Mork's Blessing
description: The Shaman blesses any friendly greenskin Hero on the table, himself included, with no need for line of sight. If that Hero is taken out of action in the game, roll a D6: on a 4+ the model that did it takes a wound with no save. The blessing lasts until the end of the game or until the Hero is taken out of action. Casting it again ends the earlier blessing.

name: We Can Fly!
description: The Shaman and the closest D6 friendly models within 6" move at once 12" towards the closest enemy model. Those that reach the enemy count as charging in the close combat phase.

name: Foot of Gork!
description: Pick an enemy model on the table at random. It and every other model, friend or foe, within 3" take D3 hits each, wounding enemies on a 3+ and models of the Snotling warband on a 5+, all at -3 to the armour save.

name: Pebbles of Doom
description: Any friendly Hero within 6" gains D6 magic pebbles, thrown or shot from a slingshot at +1 to hit and +1 Strength. They last until used up, until the Hero is taken out of action, until the end of the game, or until the spell is cast again, when the old ones vanish.

name: Pointy Stick of Death
description: The Shaman gains +2 WS and +1 Strength, and strikes first in every round of combat, even when charged. To keep it he must pass a Difficulty test at the start of each of his Recovery phases.

name: Blessing of the Shrimp
description: A Hero within 6" gains +1 WS, +1 T and +1 Leadership for D3 rounds (one round ends at the start of your next Recovery phase). On the leader, every model within 12" may use his Leadership; on another Hero, models within 6" may use his Leadership as if he were a second leader. Only one model may have it at a time: cast on another, it moves to him.

name: Soulcage
description: Choose one model within 6". Wounds the caster takes go to that model instead, at +1 to its Injury rolls. On a natural 6 on its Injury roll it is taken out of action and the caster is stunned. Only one Soulcage may be in effect at a time.

name: Black Breath
description: Range 8": the first model in its path takes 2 S4 hits, and all models within 2" take one S3 hit.

name: Servants Eternal
description: Cast before the battle, and only once: D3 Zombies join the caster's side. They turn to dust after the battle and don't count towards the warband's maximum size.

name: Fear of the Ages
description: Every enemy model within 4" of the caster takes a S3 hit with no armour save. Servants of Morr, Sigmar and Ulric take a S4 hit instead.

name: Wall of Despair
description: The caster is immune to all spells and prayers. Roll a D6 at the start of each turn in the Recovery phase: on a 1 or 2 the Wall ends.

name: Claws of Nagash
description: The caster has +1 WS and becomes frenzied. Roll a D6 at the start of each turn in the Recovery phase: on a 2 or less the Claws end.

name: Geyser
description: Range 10", never at a target up high. The target takes a S4 hit and is blown 2" in a random direction; if it hits something, both take a further S2 hit.

name: Portent of Amul
description: In this close combat phase and the opponent's next, every friendly model of the wizard's may re-roll its 1s. A re-rolled 1 stands.

name: Premonition
description: While the wizard stands, the warband has +1 Leadership and may re-roll failed Rout tests.

name: Frostbolts
description: A magic missile with a range of 16": the target takes D3 S3 hits.

name: Blindness of the Depths
description: Range 12". The target takes an Initiative test; if it fails it is blind: it can't fight, shoot or cast, and can't be charged or targeted by shooting or spells. It tests Initiative again in each of its own Recovery phases, and the spell ends when it passes.

name: Lifespring
description: One friendly model within 4" of the wizard at once regains a wound and recovers from knocked down or stunned, and may act as normal this turn.

name: Jorun's Blast of Brimstone
description: Range: the caster's Strength plus D6 inches, at a model he can see. That model and every model within 1.5" of it take a S3 hit.

name: Tazoul's Burning Skull
description: Range 8": one S5 hit. Then on a 5+ the nearest enemy model takes a S3 hit, and on a further 4+ the next nearest a S2 hit. No model is hit twice in one casting.

name: Hades Heat
description: Place the small blast template (3") anywhere within 8" of the caster. Models wholly or partly under it have -1 WS and -1 S until the caster's next turn.

name: Shield of Flame
description: The wizard has an armour save of 4+ in close combat and 5+ against ranged attacks, which don't stack with other saves and can't be modified. He uses his weapons as normal.

name: U'Zhuls Inferno
description: A pillar of flame 12" long and 1" wide: every model in its path takes a S2 hit, the target a S4 hit instead. All its hits are at -1 to armour saves.

name: Flesh of the Forge
description: Enemies are at -1 to hit the wizard in close combat. Roll a D6 in each of his Recovery phases: on a 1-2 the spell ends.

name: Flesh of Clay
description: The wizard doubles his Toughness and halves his Movement and Initiative, until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action.

name: Healing Might
description: Every model within 4" of the wizard recovers from knocked down or stunned, and every model within 2" of him regains all its wounds.

name: Curse of Thorns
description: Range 18". The target must pass a Toughness test or stay immobile, only defending itself if attacked. The spell ends when it passes a Toughness test.

name: Jozun's Decay
description: Range 12". The target must pass a Leadership test or lose 1 Toughness. In each Recovery phase it tests Leadership again, losing a further point on each failure; at 0 Toughness it is removed, whatever its wounds. Once it passes, it plays the rest of the game at its reduced Toughness. A model may be its target only once a game.

name: The Hunter's Spear
description: The wizard's weapon becomes a hunting spear, giving him +2 Strength and +1 Attack. He takes a Leadership test in each of his Recovery phases, and the spear fades when he fails.

name: Shifting Sands
description: Any enemy model the wizard can see must pass an Initiative test or count as knocked down until its next Recovery phase, when it tests again. Each friendly model within 1" of the trapped model reduces the test's difficulty by 1, to a minimum of 1.

name: Winters Gale
description: Place the large blast template (5") within 12" of the caster. Every model wholly or partly under it takes a S4 hit; Undead and Possessed models take a S2 hit instead.

name: Crows Feast
description: A magic missile with a range of 24": D6 S3 hits.

name: Dust Dervish
description: D3 Dust Dervishes each attack one model within 12" of the caster, with no other limit on targets (even a hidden model), each doing D6 S1 hits before they vanish.

name: Howler Wind
description: Cast on the wizard himself: anyone shooting mundane ranged weapons at him or a model within 8" of him is at -2 BS. Shooting past them is unaffected.

name: Celestial Shield
description: Cast on the caster or a friendly model within 6": a 4+ save against all ranged attacks and 5+ against hostile spells. If that model is the main target of an area spell and makes the save, no model suffers the spell.

name: Shade Mount
description: Cast on the wizard or a Hero within 8" of him: the model may at once fly up to 12". Reaching base contact with an enemy counts as a charge.

name: Morr's Protection
description: Negates any magical attack by a Necromancer, a Magister or Daemons directed at the priest, until the priest's next shooting phase.

name: Death Holds No Fear
description: The priest of Morr is fearless for the rest of the game.

name: Sanctity of the Fallen
description: On a model, friend or foe, taken out of action within 6" of the priest: it may not be raised by a Necromancer.

name: Hand of Morr
description: With the priest in base contact with an Undead model, before hand-to-hand combat: the foe is at once taken out of action (Zombies, Dire Wolves and Vampires). Ghouls, Possessed, Daemons and creatures of chaos flee their full Move away from the priest.

name: Do you know who I am?
description: Range 6", at the closest Undead model, else the next closest human servant of the Undead (Dregs, Ghouls, Necromancers), else any model. It is stunned, or knocked down if it can't be stunned.

name: I am death!
description: The priest has a 6+ armour save and +1 WS, or WS 4, whichever is greater. A Leadership test keeps it in later rounds.

name: Tempest Call
description: The weather turns to Raining, and every Fen Guard warrior on the table recovers 1 Wound, none above its maximum. No effect if it is raining already.

name: Return from the Wild
description: A Dryad henchman taken out of action in the last round returns, placed in a Woodland terrain feature within 6" of the Branchwych.

name: Awakening the Wood
description: Every model within 4" of a Woodland terrain feature that is within 12" of the Branchwych takes a S4 hit.

name: Traveling the Green
description: The Branchwych, or any warrior of her warband, moves from one Woodland terrain feature to any other on the table.

name: Entangle
description: One model within 24" can't move while the Branchwych stays still and alive. Both may shoot and cast spells as normal, but fight in close combat at -2 WS.

name: Unleash Spites
description: The closest enemy within 6" is attacked: roll as many dice as the casting roll's total (10 dice for a 10), and each 6 is a wound. Armour saves as normal.

name: Spell of Awakening
description: If an enemy Hero is killed (11-15 on the Serious Injury chart after the battle), the caster may raise him as a Revenant in his service. He keeps his characteristics, weapons and armour but may use no equipment or skills, may no longer run, and is a henchman group of his own.

name: Lifestealer
description: One model within 6" takes a wound, with no saves, and the caster gains a wound for the battle, even past his maximum. Not against the Possessed or any Undead model.

name: Reanimation
description: One Revenant taken out of action in the last hand-to-hand combat phase returns at once within 6" of the caster, but not into hand-to-hand combat. On a Spirit or Banshee with more than one Wound it restores 1 lost wound instead. It never returns a Spirit, Spirit Host, Banshee or Mourngul taken out of action.

name: Spell of Doom
description: One enemy model within 12" must at once roll its Strength or less on a D6, or roll on the Injury table.

name: Call of Vanhel
description: One Revenant, Spirit Host, Spirit, Poltergeist or Banshee within 6" of the caster may move again at once, up to its Movement; reaching an enemy model counts as a charge, and it passes any Initiative test this move needs.

name: Living Horror
description: Choose one model within 8" of the Wraith and roll D6+3. If the score is equal to or more than its Leadership, it takes a wound, with no armour save; if it still has wounds, it may not move, shoot or cast spells in its next turn unless it passes a Leadership test. Not against the Possessed, Undead or a model immune to fear.

name: Siren's Call
description: Range 6", cast on the closest enemy model. Roll a D6 and add the Sea Singer's Leadership; the target rolls a D6 and adds his own Leadership at -1. If her score beats his, she controls him until he passes a Leadership test at -1 in his own recovery phase. He may not kill himself, but he may attack his own side, and he will not fight warriors of her warband. If he was in hand-to-hand combat with her warband, the models move 1" apart at once.

name: March of Sorrow
description: The Sea Singer and every friendly Zombie and Skeleton within 6" of her may move up to 1D3+1" in any direction at once. A move that ends in contact with an enemy counts as a charge.

name: Wraith's Dirge
description: The closest enemy model within 6" rolls on the injury chart at once, even if he has more than one Wound; an Out of Action result costs him 1 wound. The Sea Singer may not attack in the close combat phase this turn.

name: Lover's Lament
description: Brings back into play one Bloated taken out of action last turn. It may raise a Gibbet instead, but the difficulty is then 8. Place the model within 6" of the Sea Singer, not in hand-to-hand combat.

name: Song of Discord
description: Every enemy warrior within 6" of the Sea Singer must re-roll his successful Leadership tests, unless he is immune to psychology. She must pass a Leadership test at the start of each recovery phase to keep the spell up, and it ends if she is stunned, taken out of action or casts another spell.

name: Dark Compact
description: Whenever an enemy Hero dies he is taken by the warband instead and offered a place in it. Pressgang him as a captured Hero, into a Cursed or a Bloated, by the normal pressgang recruitment rules. He may not be ransomed back.

name: Divination of Shirath
description: The Mage may re-roll all his failed dice rolls, though the second result stands. The effect lasts until the beginning of the Mage’s next turn.

name: Shimmering Shield
description: This spell acts as a shield to protect the Mage. It gives him an additional unmodified 5+ save against all attacks. The effect lasts until the beginning of the Mage’s next turn.

name: Statue of Light
description: The Mage chooses a single enemy model he can see. That model may not move as long as the Mage remains both static and alive. The Mage and the target may cast spells normally, but fight in close combat at -2 WS (minimum of 1).

name: Mistress of the Deep
description: Place a man-sized Oceanid model within 6" of the Mist Mage. It never moves or acts and counts as scenery. Before an enemy shoots at or charges the Mist Mage it measures to the Oceanid, and if the Oceanid is the closer it must pass a Leadership test or do neither this turn; once it passes one it need not test again. It has no effect on a model immune to psychology. The spell ends when the Mage wishes, when he casts another spell, or when he recasts this one, which moves the Oceanid within 6" of him.

name: Hunter's Fury
description: The spell summons D3+1 arrows which the Mage can use to shoot against one enemy model following the rules for normal shooting. The arrows have a range of 36". Use the Mage’s own Ballistic Skill to determine whether he hits or not, but ignore movement, range and cover penalties. Each arrow causes one S3 hit.

name: Silent Guardian
description: This spell acts as an invisible guardian that will defend the Mage. If the Mage is attacked in close combat then the guardian will fight first with WS5, S3. The guardian will make 1 attack per turn against each enemy that attacks the Mage. The guardian will not leave the Mage’s side, and will only fight if the Mage himself is being attacked. The Guardian cannot be attacked in return and will only be dispelled if the Mage casts another spell or dies.

name: Offense
description: A single friendly construct within 6" gains +1 to hit in hand-to-hand combat, and its enemies gain +1 to hit it. Lasts until the beginning of the Clockworkers' next shooting phase.

name: Motion
description: A single friendly construct within 6" may immediately move again up to its full Movement. If this brings it into base contact with an enemy model, it counts as charging.

name: Defense
description: A single friendly construct within 8" may not attack in close combat, but may re-roll every attempt to parry, and enemy models in base contact lose 1 Attack. Lasts until the beginning of the Clockworkers' next shooting phase.

name: Sacrifice
description: A single friendly construct within 10" is immediately taken out of action and suffers -2 on its roll for serious injuries. Every model within 4" of where it stood suffers D3 automatic hits at a Strength equal to the construct's Toughness, obstacles casting shadows as they do against a blunderbuss. The winning warband may sell the scraps after the game for 2D6 gold crowns.

name: Protection
description: May be used only while the caster is in hand-to-hand combat. Move him up to 2" out of combat and place one friendly construct within 4" in base contact with his former foes. If that construct was itself in hand-to-hand combat it breaks free at once, and each enemy model it leaves gets an automatic hit as if it had failed an All Alone test.

name: Rampage
description: Every close combat attack by a single friendly construct within 6" gains Barrage: when it hits but fails to wound it may attack again at -1 to hit, and again while it keeps hitting, down to needing a 6 to hit. Lasts until the beginning of the Clockworkers' next shooting phase.

name: Hit da Mark
description: Every member of the warband within 6" of the Magi may re-roll his failed hand-to-hand attacks this turn.

name: Yer not Lookin'
description: Cast at any model within 8" of the Magi. It may not move or shoot and its Weapon Skill counts as 1. The spell lasts for the rest of the Magi's turn and through the target's next turn, and ends at the start of the Magi's following turn.

name: Sticka Storm
description: The spell draws D3+1 barbed arrows into being, with a range of 24". The Magi fires them at any single enemy model using his Ballistic Skill, ignoring the modifiers for range, movement and cover. Each arrow is Strength 3 and adds +1 to the injury roll.

name: Dig in Ladz
description: One Hobgoblin within 4" strikes first in hand-to-hand combat whatever else applies, except magic. If both sides are allowed to strike first by magic the combat is simultaneous. It lasts until the start of the Magi's next turn.

name: Feel da Burn!
description: Every model within 8" of the Magi takes one Strength 4 hit, with no save allowed.

name: One of Uz, One of Uz!
description: Cast at one enemy model within 12". It must test on the Treacherous Gits table as a Hobgoblin Henchman does. If it ends the game on the Hobgoblin side it becomes a Hobgoblin and joins the warband as a Thievin' Git at the start of the next battle; if the warband already holds 15 members the Hobgoblin player either dismisses a member or returns the model to its own warband.

name: Word of Power
description: Any enemy within 8" of the wizard suffers -3 Weapon Skill, to a minimum of 1. This lasts until the beginning of the wizard's next turn.

name: Fiery Wrath
description: Range 12". The target is hit at Strength 4. Every model within 3" of the target suffers a Strength 3 hit on a D6 roll of 4+. Armour saves are taken as normal.

name: The Phoenix Crown
description: The wizard has an armour save of 2+, which replaces his normal armour save, and gains +2 Weapon Skill and +1 Strength. Roll at the beginning of each turn in the recovery phase: on a D6 roll of 1 or 2 the crown disappears.

name: Roar of the Dragon
description: Range 12", in an absolutely straight line. Any model in its path must roll equal to or under its Strength or be knocked down. The spell stops if it hits a building.

name: The Anger of the Earth
description: Draw a straight line 12" long and 1" wide from the wizard in any direction. Any model in its path suffers a single Strength 5 hit.

name: The Light of Glory
description: Any friendly model within 8" of the wizard is immune to psychology and will never break from combat. This lasts until the wizard suffers a wound; when he does, every model within 8" must take a Leadership test and any model that fails is treated as having failed an All Alone test.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Range 24", Strength 3. Roll to hit with the wizard's Ballistic Skill. If it hits, roll a D6: on a 5+ the bolt arcs to the next closest model within 6", and keeps arcing until there is no target left or the roll is under 5. On a 1 for the arc, the wizard takes a hit at the spell's Strength as his warp blades overload. The spell may be cast in close combat instead: it then automatically inflicts D3 hits on the wizard and on every model in base contact with him.

name: Winds of Judgement
description: Every model except the Shaman must pass a Strength test or be knocked down. A model knocked down this way is also scattered D6" with no further damage.

name: Rage!
description: One friendly model, the Shaman included, is frenzied until it is knocked down or the battle ends. Only one model at a time may be frenzied this way.

name: Warrior's Charge
description: The Shaman may move up to 8". If he moves into base contact he counts as charging and fights at +1 Strength that turn. If he reaches a fleeing model he scores one automatic hit at +1 Strength.

name: Erga Unga's Toughness
description: One friendly model gains +1 Toughness for D3 turns. The spell may be cast on more than one model.

name: Mead of Unga Cha Beecha
description: Every model within 2" of the Shaman is restored to its full Wounds. In addition, every living enemy model within 4" of the Shaman must pass a Toughness test or lose 1 Attack for that turn.

name: Arrows of Leggit Og
description: The Shaman fires D3 Strength 4 arrows, rolling to hit with his Ballistic Skill and ignoring all to hit modifiers.

name: Blast 1
