description: A missile with a range of 18" strikes the target and every model within 2" of it, friend or foe. Each model struck suffers one Strength 4 hit.

name: Blast 2
description: The spell targets the nearest enemy within 12". The target suffers D3 Strength 4 hits.

name: Blast 3
description: Range 12". The spell strikes the first model in its path, which suffers D3 Strength 5 hits. Roll to hit with the caster's Ballistic Skill; the normal rules and modifiers for shooting apply.

name: Buff
description: Target one friendly model within 2", the caster included. It gains +1 Initiative and +2 Strength until it suffers an unsaved wound.

name: Ward
description: Target one friendly model within 2", the caster included. It gains a 4+ ward save. The caster must pass a Leadership test in each recovery phase to keep it.

name: De-buff
description: Range 24". The target enemy is -1 to hit. It ends when the target rolls a 4 or more in the recovery phase.

name: Rune of Iron
description: One friendly model within 4" gains a 5+ armour save, or +2 to the armour save he already has. It lasts until the beginning of the Runesmith's next shooting phase.

name: Rune of Hearth and Home
description: Every friendly model within 3" that is stunned becomes knocked down, and every one that is knocked down stands up and fights as normal.

name: Rune of Shielding
description: Every model within 4" of the Runesmith, friend or foe, gains the Dodge rule until the beginning of the Runesmith's next shooting phase.

name: Rune of Destruction
description: A bolt of lightning strikes one target within 12" and in sight for one Strength 4 hit, ignoring all armour saves.

name: Rune of Melting Steel
description: One model within 4" loses every close combat and missile weapon but his shield and may fight only with his bare fists, for 2 turns. It has no effect on a model with No Pain.

name: Rune of Fury
description: One friendly model within 4" gains +2 Initiative, +1 Attack and the Web of Steel rule until your close combat phase.

name: Raise our insignia!
description: This Command may be shouted only to the Squire, and only while he is within 12" and is not fleeing, knocked down, stunned or out of action. Until the beginning of the next shooting phase every model of the warband, the Wandering knight included, who has line of sight to the Squire may re-roll a failed Leadership test, the warband's rout test included.

name: Move, ye miscreant!
description: One warrior of the warband within 6" of the Wandering knight immediately moves again, up to his full Movement. If this brings him into base contact with an enemy model he counts as charging.

name: Follow me, mine pugnacious ones!
description: Every member of the warband within 4" of the Wandering knight gains +1 to hit in hand-to-hand combat until the end of the turn.

name: Be on guard, my brave ones!
description: Choose a member of the warband within 12" who is engaged in hand-to-hand combat. He immediately moves away from the combat, up to his full Movement, and may not come into contact with another enemy model.

name: Pay them no heed!
description: Choose a model of the warband within 12". Until the next shooting phase he may shoot at any enemy warrior, even one who is not the closest.

name: Art thou ready to die fighting?
description: Every model of the warband within 4", the Wandering knight included, can be taken out of action only on a roll of 6, until the warband's next turn.

name: Unnerving gaze
description: Every attack against the Dame in hand-to-hand combat is at -1 to hit, and every enemy model in base contact with her strikes last, whatever its target. This lasts until the beginning of the Order of the Mare player's next shooting phase.

name: Phantom hoof
description: One enemy warrior within 6" of the Dame suffers a Strength 5 hit with the concussion special rule.

name: Dame's inspiration
description: The Dame's attacks in hand-to-hand combat gain +1 to hit and +1 Strength. At the start of each of her turns she rolls 2D6: on the prayer's difficulty or more the effect stays in play.

name: Thirst for valour
description: One ally within 12", not the Dame herself, becomes frenzied. Only one warrior may be frenzied this way at a time: if the Dame chooses a new one, the first loses the frenzy.

name: Aura of dauntlessness
description: For the rest of the battle the save from the Dame's own armour and from a friendly Companion filly's covering is increased by 1, and every other member of the warband gains an unmodifiable 6+ save against a non-magical attack, in addition to and taken after any other save.

name: The Dame's charger
description: The Dame counts as mounted on a warhorse with the profile M8 WS4 BS0 S4 T4 W1 I4 A2 Ld7, until the end of the game or until she is dismounted. The charger gives no armour save of its own, but increases the save from the Dame's own armour by 1, and the Dame and the charger cause fear.

name: Wyrdstone Fever
description: Every member of the warband within range is immune to fear while the rant continues.

name: Ultimate Conviction
description: The Prophet becomes frenzied for as long as the rant continues. No other model in range is affected.

name: Remembrance
description: While the rant continues the warband may re-roll a failed rout test, and may not voluntarily rout.

name: Call To Arms
description: Cast after both warbands are deployed but before the game starts. The warband receives D3 extra City Folk, each armed with a dagger and a club. They do not join the warband after the game.

name: Guardians of the City
description: Every member of the warband within range hates every enemy warband for as long as the rant continues.

name: Doom Chant
description: Every member of the warband within range may re-roll one failed to-wound roll in hand-to-hand combat for as long as the rant continues.

name: Ignifer
description: The Alchemist's Apprentice can make Firebombs. In the trading phase roll a D6: 1-2 one Firebomb, 3-4 two, 5-6 three. He may make only one kind of Heresy of Alchemy in a trading phase.

name: Devorantis
description: The Alchemist's Apprentice can make Acid Bombs. In the trading phase roll a D6: 1-2 one Acid Bomb, 3-4 two, 5-6 three. He may make only one kind of Heresy of Alchemy in a trading phase.

name: Odoris
description: The Alchemist's Apprentice can make Stink Bombs. In the trading phase roll a D6: 1-2 one Stink Bomb, 3-4 two, 5-6 three. He may make only one kind of Heresy of Alchemy in a trading phase.

name: Fumus
description: The Alchemist's Apprentice can make Smoke Bombs. In the trading phase roll a D6: 1-2 one Smoke Bomb, 3-4 two, 5-6 three. He may make only one kind of Heresy of Alchemy in a trading phase.

name: Incremento
description: When the warband sells wyrdstone in the campaign phase he may try to duplicate the number of shards sold. Roll a D6: on a 1 a shard crumbles to dust and is lost, on a 2-3 nothing happens, on a 4-5 +1 wyrdstone and on a 6 +2 wyrdstone.

name: Magnum Opus
description: The Alchemist's Apprentice is an apprentice no longer. He chooses one spell from the Lesser Magic list, and may take Lesser Magic when he advances.

name: Scripted
description: Every friendly model within 12" of the caster may re-roll a failed roll to hit, and every enemy model must re-roll a hit. The second result stands. It lasts until the start of the caster's next turn.

name: Soliloquy
description: Every enemy model within 8" counts as knocked down, those in hand-to-hand combat included. Jump Up does not help them, since they were not knocked down by an injury roll.

name: Our Story Thus Far
description: The spell runs over three turns, and the caster may cast no other spell while it is in play, though he may attack and defend as normal. Act 1, For Glory: in the turn it is cast every friendly model may charge up to 2" beyond its maximum charge range, and one that had been charged counts as the charger even if it was charged that turn. Act 2, Despair: in the second turn every friendly model must pass a Leadership test or strike last at -2 to hit, and every friendly model is at -1 to hit whether it passes or not. Act 3, Triumph: in the third turn every friendly model hits automatically with its first attack and is at +1 to hit with each attack after it, and may re-roll a failed roll to hit, the second result standing.

name: Fehu
description: The rune of wealth. If the werewolf it was inscribed on did not go out of action, he may take a Leadership test at the start of the exploration phase. If he passes, he dictates the result of his own exploration dice, before any other exploration dice are rolled. A re-roll may be used on a dictated die, but its result is then random.

name: Algiz
description: The rune of protection. The warrior it is inscribed on gains a 6+ save against all hits and may re-roll any failed test except a rout test. If he already has a save against hits, he gains +1 to that save instead.

name: Kenaz
description: The rune of fire, inscribed on a weapon; werewolf claws count as one. The fighter carrying it may take a Leadership test at the start of his turn: if he passes, his attacks gain +1 Strength and are flaming, and he counts as a light source, until the start of his next turn.

name: Isa
description: The rune of ice, inscribed on the armour of the Rünwulf or a companion. He gains +1 to his armour save and is immune to any hot or cold weather effect.

name: Dagaz
description: The rune of luck, on an amulet. The fighter gains D6 re-rolls, usable on any dice in the game; any left over may be used in the exploration phase.

name: Thurisaz
description: The rune of the giant, cut into the subject's skin. He gains +2 Movement, +2 Strength and +2 Wounds, becomes a Large Target, and may use no weapon or armour. It is cast in the Equip phase of the post-game sequence, and his weapons and armour go to the stash in the normal way.

name: Angering Spites
description: Range 18". One Strength 4 hit on the first model in its path, with armour saves as normal.

name: Oakskin
description: The wizard gains a 2+ armour save, which replaces any other armour save he has.

name: Terrifying Spites
description: Choose a friendly model within 8", the wizard himself among them. That model causes fear for the rest of the battle. The spell may be cast successfully only once per battle.

name: Fury of the Wild
description: The wizard gains +1 Movement, +1 Attack, +2 Strength and +1 Weapon Skill. He must pass a Leadership test at the start of each of his own turns to keep it; the spell ends when he fails.

name: Ever-Living Resplendence
description: One model within 4" of the wizard, himself among them, is restored to its full Wounds. It may instead be used on a friendly model within 4" that is stunned or knocked down: it comes to its senses at once, stands up and fights on as normal.

name: Call of the Hunt
description: One friendly model within 8" of the caster gains +1 to hit and +1 on its injury rolls in its next turn of shooting or close combat.

name: Frost
description: Range 16". The target must roll equal to or under its Toughness on a D6 or suffer a wound. A 6 always fails.

name: Cone of Ice
description: Range: the large flame template. Every model wholly or partly under it suffers a Strength 3 hit. No critical hits.

name: Freezing Cold
description: Range 8". The target must roll equal to or under its Toughness or be stunned, however many wounds it has.

name: Hail
description: Range 12", cast on one model. That model suffers 1D3+3 Strength 2 hits and every model within 2" suffers D3 Strength 2 hits. No critical hits. The target is also at -1 to hit when shooting in its next turn.

name: Numming Cold
description: Range 8". The target is at -1 on injury rolls, and a wound whose injury roll comes out as 1 is wasted; it is also at -2 Initiative, to a minimum of 1. It must roll a D6: on a 1 it rolls another D6, where 1-3 knocks it down, 4-5 stuns it and a 6 takes it out of action. It lasts until the beginning of the caster's next turn.

name: Ice Patch
description: Range 6", cast at the beginning of the movement phase. The target must pass an Initiative test or be knocked down. No model may charge it or come within 4" of it. A model already within 4" must move out in its own movement phase, passing an Initiative test to do so or falling down. A model in hand-to-hand combat with it is separated from it as both fight to keep their balance.

name: Fireball
description: Range 16". One model in line of sight takes a Strength 5 hit.

name: Fairy Fire
description: Range 8". The target causes fear, is at +1 to be hit by shooting and may not hide. Roll a D6 in each of the caster's recovery phases: on a 1 or a 2 the spell ends.

name: Smoke
description: Range 6". The target and every model within 3" of it count as being in cover. It lasts until the beginning of the caster's next turn.

name: Burning Ring
description: Range: the caster. Every model within 2" of him takes one Strength 3 hit. A model trying to charge him must pass a fear test, even one that causes fear itself, and takes one Strength 3 hit if the charge succeeds. It lasts until the caster's next recovery phase.

name: Burning Hand
description: Range: the caster. He may give up all his attacks to make one hand-to-hand attack at Strength 5 that causes 2 wounds. If it hits, the model hit catches fire on a 4+.

name: Inferno
description: Range 12". The target suffers D3 Strength 5 hits and every model within 4" of it suffers one Strength 3 hit, all at +1 on injury rolls. On a 4+ the target catches fire, and on a 5+ every model within 4" catches fire.

name: Riding the Wind
description: Range: the caster. He may move anywhere up to 12+2D3", but not into base contact with an enemy model.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Range 12". The target takes one Strength 6 hit, or D3 Strength 6 hits if it wears heavy armour, light armour and a shield, Ithilmar armour or Gromril armour.

name: Fog
description: Range: the caster. He counts as being in cover and strikes first in hand-to-hand combat, even against spears.

name: Gale Blades
description: Range 12". The caster shoots 2D3+2 Strength 3 attacks, rolling to hit with no modifiers.

name: Twister
description: Range 12", at one model not in hand-to-hand combat. The caster rolls 2D6 and the target rolls a D6, adding its Strength and 1 more if it is a large target. If the caster's roll is higher, the target scatters 2D6" in a random direction and suffers one hit at a Strength equal to the distance it moved, and in its next turn it acts as though it had been knocked down and just got up. If the two rolls are equal it scatters D3" in a random direction and may not run next turn. If the target's roll is higher, nothing happens to it.

name: Wall of Wind
description: Range: the caster. Shooting at him or at any model within 2" of him is at -2 to hit.

name: Stone Skin
description: Range 6". The target gets +2 on his armour save. The spell ends in any recovery phase in which the caster is more than 6" away, and the caster must pass the casting roll in every recovery phase to keep it up. Only one model may be stone skinned at a time.

name: Earthquake
description: Every model within 8" of the caster must pass an Initiative test or be knocked down, and no model within that 8" may run next turn.

name: Mud
description: Range 8". The target may not move, but fights back if it is charged. It lasts until the caster's next turn.

name: Stone Guardian
description: Cast before the battle: it summons a stone guardian, which must stay within 8" of the caster. Its profile is M5 WS2 BS0 S4 T4 W2 I1 A2 Ld10 with an armour save of 5+, and it is immune to poison and to psychology, may not run and causes fear.

name: Stone Hands
description: Range 6". The target is attacked by two stone hands with Weapon Skill 4, Strength 4 and 2 Attacks. The attacks can be parried. It lasts for one hand-to-hand phase.

name: Earth Lore
description: Cast after the battle. The caster may re-roll one dice and change one dice by +1 or -1, and the two need not be the same dice. He may not re-roll a re-roll. If he was taken out of action the spell may not be used.

name: Light
description: A wizard or cleric casts the spell on himself or another warrior within 12". That model counts as carrying a torch, but keeps his hands free. Every turn the caster must roll a D6: on a 1 or 2 the Light disappears.

name: Silence
description: The wizard encircles one enemy model within 24" with a sphere of silence: it cannot cast spells, or sound the alarm if it is a sentry. It shrugs off the spell if it passes a Leadership test in its recovery phase.

name: Curse of Form
description: The wizard turns a model within 8" into a Mule or a Wardog for D6 turns. The afflicted warrior remains in the control of his owning player.

name: Shroud of Darkness
description: The Magister cloaks himself in shadows. He counts as being in constant cover, so may hide, and walk without revealing himself.

name: Summon Skeletons
description: The wizard raises the dead that lie under the earth he walks upon. Place D3 skeletons within 3" of the necromancer; any that end up in contact with an enemy model count as charging. The spell can only be cast once per game, and only in desert locales.

name: Control Undead
description: The necromancer tries to wrest control of an undead creature from its master: any enemy zombie, skeleton, dire wolf or sgull within 12". He and the enemy wizard who controls it each roll 2D6, adding any modifiers they would receive for casting a spell (+1 for Sorcery, for example). If the caster of Control Undead scores higher, he controls the creature for the rest of the battle.

name: Rune of Stone
description: The warrior carrying the item has +1 to his armour save.

name: Rune of Sharpness
description: The weapon gives a further -1 to the armour save of any model it hits.

name: Rune of Speed
description: The warrior's Initiative is doubled while he fights with the weapon.

name: Rune of Warding
description: Inscribed on a belt, an armband or the like, it gives the warrior a special 4+ save against any spell that affects him. Replacing the item costs 1 gc.

name: Rune of Accuracy
description: The warrior has +1 to hit with the weapon.

name: Rune of Striding
description: Inscribed on boots, a belt or the like, it gives the warrior +1 Movement. Replacing the item costs 1 gc.

name: Rune of Iron
description: Inscribed on armour: its wearer has a 6+ ward save.

name: Rune of Stone
description: Inscribed on armour: +1 to its wearer's armour save.

name: Rune of Fury
description: Inscribed on a weapon: its wielder has +1 Attack.

name: Rune of Striking
description: Inscribed on a weapon: its wielder has +1 Weapon Skill.

name: Rune of Speed
description: Inscribed on a weapon: its wielder has +1 Initiative.

name: Rune of Cleaving
description: Inscribed on a weapon: its wielder has +1 Strength.

name: Potion of Flames
description: Used on one weapon, which counts as +1 Strength. A creature susceptible to fire suffers 2 wounds instead of one. After the battle roll a D6: on a 1 the weapon is burnt and worthless.

name: Leather Skin Potion
description: The drinker's skin gives a 5+ armour save, which may not be modified beyond 6+. It cannot be used while he wears body armour, but may be combined with a shield. After the battle roll a D6: on a 1 the skin tears and he must roll on the Serious Injury table, rolling again for death, capture and sold to the pits.

name: Muscle Potion
description: The drinker is +1 Strength for the rest of the battle, which may take him beyond his racial maximum. After the battle roll a D6: on a 1 he is -1 Strength for the next battle.

name: Exploding Potion
description: Thrown, and explodes on its target with a S5 hit. If it misses it rolls D3" in a random direction and explodes there; on a 1 to hit it goes D3" in a random direction from the thrower. Everything within 1" of the explosion takes a S3 hit.

name: Berserker Potion
description: The drinker becomes frenzied. After the battle roll a D6: on a 1 he is too ill to fight and misses the next battle.

name: Potion of Speed
description: Rubbed on one warrior's legs and arms, he is +1 Movement and +1 Initiative for the battle. Drunk instead, his Initiative becomes 10 and his Movement 6, but he falls ill and misses the next game. The Alchemist will never drink it himself.

name: Pha's Protection
description: A friendly model within 6" gains +2 to its armour save. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: The Speed of Light
description: Every friendly model within 3" gains +1 Weapon Skill and +3 Initiative until the start of the wizard's next recovery phase.

name: Light of Battle
description: Every friendly model within 6" is immune to fear until your next recovery phase. Every Undead and Daemon model within 6" must pass an All Alone test on its own Leadership or flee from combat.

name: Net of Amyntok
description: Pick one model within 12" and in line of sight. Until your next recovery phase it must pass a Strength test before any action other than close combat; if it fails, it takes D3 Strength 1 hits.

name: Banishment
description: One enemy model within 24" of the wizard takes a Strength 10 hit. Every model within 2" of it, friend or foe, must pass an Initiative test or be stunned by the glare. Daemon, Mutant and Undead models are taken out of action outright, and any Daemon Soul mutation is removed.

name: Birona's Timewarp
description: Until the wizard's next recovery phase, every friendly model within 6" has +1 to hit and causes a critical hit on a 5+ whatever its Strength, and every enemy model within 6" has -1 to hit and strikes last with all its attacks.

name: Searing Doom
description: The wizard fires D6+2 slivers of metal at one enemy model within 24", using his own Ballistic Skill with no modifiers at all. Each sliver is Strength 3 with -2 to the target's armour save.

name: Plague of Rust
description: One enemy in line of sight has -1 to its armour save. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: Enchanted Blade of Aiban
description: For one turn, one model within 6" has +1 to hit, and its attacks give -2 to the armour save.

name: Gehenna's Golden Hounds
description: Two enemy models wearing armour, within 12" and in line of sight, each take a Strength 5 hit with no armour save.

name: Fault of Form
description: One metal weapon within 12" loses all its weapon bonuses and, if it is a weapon that can misfire, misfires on a 1-2. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: Final Transmutation
description: Roll a D6 for one model within 12" with an armour save of 5+ or better: on a 6+ it is killed outright, turned into a golden statue. Any model may claim the statue, which is carried like a crate (by two models) and sells for 250 gc.

name: Earth Blood
description: One model within 6" that stands on the ground, not inside a building, gains a 4+ regeneration save. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks. It also ends when the model leaves the ground.

name: Awakening of the Wood
description: Place a piece of wooded terrain no larger than 4" by 4" anywhere within 6". Every enemy caught in it when it appears takes D3 Strength 3 hits.

name: Flesh to Stone
description: One model within 6" gains +2 Toughness and -2 Movement. A model in water sinks to the bottom and is taken out of action, Aquatic or not. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: Shield of Thorns
description: At the end of each close combat phase, every model in base contact with the wizard takes a Strength 3 hit. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: Vital Growth
description: The wizard, or any model within 3" of him at ground level, may at once climb up to 12" without taking a test.

name: The Dwellers Below
description: One chosen model within 18" must pass a Strength test or be stunned for the rest of the game, even a model that could not normally be stunned.

name: Iceshard Blizzard
description: One enemy model in line of sight must re-roll every successful missile hit and may not use another model's Leadership. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: Harmonic Convergence
description: Until your next recovery phase, every member of your warband within 6" may re-roll results of 1.

name: Wind Blast
description: One model within 24" is pushed D6+2" directly away from the wizard.

name: Curse of the Midnight Wind
description: Until your next recovery phase, every enemy model within 12" must re-roll results of 6.

name: Thorsen's Thunderstorm
description: Draw a line 2D6" long from the wizard. Every model under it takes a Strength 3 hit; a model wearing any armour takes it at +1 Strength and with +1 to the injury roll.

name: Comet of Casandora
description: Pick a spot on the board: the comet arrives in D3-1 turns. On that turn roll a scatter dice and an artillery dice: it lands that far from the spot in that direction, or on the spot itself on a hit or a misfire. It is a small blast template, and every model under it takes D3 Strength 10 hits.

name: Melkoth's Mystifying Miasma
description: One enemy model within 12" has -1 Movement and must re-roll every roll made with its Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill or Initiative. It is Enduring until the model passes a Leadership test in its own turn, which breaks it.

name: The Enfeebling Foe
description: One enemy model within 6" has -2 Strength. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: The Withering
description: One enemy model within 6" has -2 Toughness. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: The Penumbral Pendulum
description: Pick an enemy within 12" and draw a line D6" long through it, in any direction. Every model under the line takes a Strength 3 hit and is knocked down.

name: Pit of Shades
description: Place a small blast template on an empty space (with no models under it) within 6" of the wizard. A model that falls into the pit falls 2D6" to the bottom, rolled for each model. The pit stays until the wizard casts the spell again, when it is removed and the new one placed.

name: Okkam's Mindrazor
description: One friendly model within 6", the wizard included, rolls to wound with its Leadership instead of its Strength, and may not add any skill or weapon bonus to it. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: Spirit Leech
description: Pick a warrior within 12" and roll a D6: on a 4+ he loses a wound and the wizard gains one.

name: Aspect of the Dreadknight
description: The wizard causes fear for the rest of the battle, even to Undead models.

name: The Caress of Laniph
description: Pick a model within 6". The wizard and the target each roll a D6 and add their Leadership; the target loses 1 wound for every point the wizard wins by.

name: Soulblight
description: Every enemy within 6" has -1 Strength and -1 Toughness, and one with the Daemon Soul mutation must pass a Leadership test or lose it. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: Doom and Darkness
description: One enemy in line of sight has -3 Leadership and must re-roll its successful Leadership tests. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: The Purple Sun of Xereus
description: Place a purple orb the size of a small blast template directly in front of the wizard. In each movement phase it moves D6" in the direction of the scatter dice, and any model it stops on (not one it only passes over) is taken out of action. It lasts until a hit is rolled on the scatter dice.

name: Fireball
description: The wizard hurls a fireball 18" that hits the first enemy in its path at Strength 3, as fire damage, with armour saves as normal. He may take a Strength 1 flaming hit to raise its Strength by 1, and may do it again and again, each time taking one hit more at 1 Strength more.

name: Cascading Fire-Cloak
description: One warrior within 6" gains a 5+ armour save, and every enemy attacking him must roll to see whether it is set on fire. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: Flaming Sword of Rhuin
description: The wizard gains +1 Attack and +1 Strength, and all his attacks are flaming. He takes a Leadership test at the start of each of his own turns, and the sword vanishes when he fails.

name: The Burning Head
description: Draw a line 8" long and 1" wide from the wizard. Every model under it takes a Strength 3 flaming hit.

name: Fulminating Flame Cage
description: One enemy within 24" and in line of sight is caged in flame: if it tries to move it is set on fire automatically. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks. The warrior also breaks it by stepping out of the cage.

name: Flame Storm
description: Cast only on a burning building, which explodes and collapses: every model within D6+2" of it takes D3 Strength 5 flaming hits.

name: The Flock of Doom
description: One enemy within 12" of the wizard takes 2D6 Strength 1 hits with no armour saves.

name: Pann's Impenetrable Pelt
description: One friendly model within 6", the caster included, gains a 2+ armour save, which may add to the save it already has and is modified as usual. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: The Amber Spear
description: One enemy within 36" and in line of sight takes a Strength 5 hit. The spear goes on through: the model directly behind it takes a Strength 4 hit, the one behind that a Strength 3 hit, and so on down to Strength 1.

name: The Curse of Anraheir
description: Pick a terrain piece within 18": it counts as difficult ground, and every enemy model in it has -1 on all its attacks.

name: The Savage Beast of Horrors
description: One friendly model within 6" of the wizard gains +1 Strength and frenzy. The spell is Enduring: it lasts until the wizard ends it at the start of a magic phase, or until he is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action, and may be cast again, even on the same target. While it lasts, every other spell he attempts is at +1 difficulty, and this stacks.

name: Transformation of Kadon
description: Pick an animal, monster or great beast on the board: the wizard becomes a copy of it for the rest of the game and may cast no more spells. He can do nothing after the game while he recovers, and becoming a Great Beast also makes him miss the next battle, though he may take part in its trading phase.

name: Blessed Voyage
description: If the Priest began the battle upon water and stays upon water for the whole battle, any one dice result may be re-rolled during the post battle sequence. Upon water means standing on a jetty or a watercraft, or being in the water.

name: Curse of the Albatross
description: For the next round of close combat, enemy warriors within 24" of the Priest suffer a critical hit on a roll of 5 or 6 instead of a 6.

name: Drowned Man's Face
description: An enemy warrior within 18" of the Priest takes a +1 modifier to all characteristic tests. In each of his recovery phases his player may try to break the prayer by passing a Toughness test with no modifier. When the prayer ends the warrior suffers a Strength 2 hit.

name: Sea Legs
description: An enemy warrior within 18" of the Priest must pass an Initiative test or be knocked down. A warrior knocked down by it may only stand up by passing an Initiative test with a +1 modifier.

name: Water Blast
description: A model within 18" of the Priest is struck by a magical Strength 4 blast of water and must pass a Strength test or be knocked down. The blast puts out any fire within 2" of its target.

name: Waterwalk
description: In the next movement phase the Priest may walk on water, marsh and swampland as if it were firm ground. The prayer lasts until he returns to solid ground.

name: Destroy Undead
description: The Priest must be touching an enemy Undead or Daemon model. If successful the foe is at once taken out of action (Zombies, Dire Wolves, Vampires and the like). Ghouls, Possessed and Daemons affected instead flee their full Move away from the Priest.

name: Glimpse Ahead
description: The Priest may modify the result of one roll he makes by +1 or -1. Once cast successfully it can't be cast again in the battle. If the modifier wasn't used in the battle, it may be applied to a roll the Priest makes in the post battle sequence when searching for a Rare item or visiting a location.

name: Preserve Corpse
description: The Priest may sanctify a model (friend or foe) that has been taken out of action within 6" of him. If successful, the model may not be raised by a Necromancer.

name: Sign of the Raven
description: During the next close combat phase all friendly models within 6", the Priest included, get +1 on all rolls to wound.

name: Sleep of Death
description: Draw a 12" line from the Priest. Each enemy model under the line must pass a Leadership test or fall asleep for D6 turns (roll for each model). A sleeping model counts as knocked down. Undead are immune.

name: Threshold Line
description: Mark a 4" line across a walkway, doorway, stair or other way in. An Undead creature must pass a Leadership test with a +1 modifier before it may cross it. The line lasts for the rest of the battle.

name: Blazing Sun
description: Every model within 4" of the Priestess suffers a Strength 3 hit with no armour save and must pass a Leadership test or be knocked down. The War-Priestess herself is unaffected.

name: Command the Legion
description: A warrior in the Priestess's line of sight gets +1 Leadership until the start of her player's next turn.

name: Dismay Foe
description: This turn any model attacking the Priestess in close combat must pass a Leadership test or make no attacks. Undead are immune.

name: Eagle's Vision
description: The War-Priestess reveals any hidden warrior. She can't use this prayer if she has moved this turn or is in close combat.

name: Fury's Call
description: During the next close combat phase all friendly models within 12", not the Priestess herself, may re-roll their first missed attack.

name: Vengeful Wrath
description: The War-Priestess may re-roll every failed roll to hit the next time she fights a round of hand-to-hand combat. Until that combat starts she must charge any enemy model within charge range: the player has no choice.

name: Bamboozle
description: An enemy warrior within 12" of the Priest must pass a Leadership test or be controlled by the Priest's player during the next turn. He may be made to do something that harms him, but may not attack himself. Large models, Daemons and Undead are immune.

name: Bargain Hunter
description: In the next post battle sequence Common items cost a third less (fractions rounded down), for every warband, and one Hero of the Priest's warband is guided to a Rare item of his choice at its normal cost. Once cast successfully it can't be used again.

name: Bountiful Fortune
description: The Priest and each warrior of his warband within 12" may each reverse the odds of one dice roll or characteristic test: a warrior who needs a 6 to hit hits on 1-5 instead. Lasts until the start of his player's next turn.

name: Open
description: A lock, bolt or latch the Priest is touching comes open, magical locks included.

name: Rumour of Bounty, Rumour of Dearth
description: In the next post battle sequence, either all equipment of one type costs half (bows 5 gc) or a Rare item becomes Common; or all equipment of one type costs double (bows 20 gc) or a Common item becomes Rare 10. The rumour affects every warband. Once cast successfully it can't be used again.

name: Stealth
description: The Priest is hidden until the start of his player's next turn. Any attempt to detect or spot him fails unless made by magical means.

name: Cure Disease
description: The Priestess, or a model in contact with her, is cured of a disease and all its ill effects.

name: Cure Wounds
description: The Priestess, or a model in contact with her, at once recovers 1 Wound.

name: Golden Tears
description: Only if the Priestess can reach the spot where a warrior was taken out of action in the previous turn: he is healed and returns to play there with 1 Wound, knocked down.

name: Purify
description: Every warrior of a Carnival of Chaos warband, or other servant of Onogal the Fly Lord, within 24" of the Priestess loses D6 Wounds whatever his Toughness or armour. One reduced to 0 Wounds must also pass a Leadership test or be stunned.

name: Shallya's Endurance
description: The Priestess, or a model in contact with her, gets +1 Toughness during the next round of close combat.

name: Vestment of Purity
description: The Priestess becomes immune to all poisons and diseases, and Daemons, warriors of a Carnival of Chaos warband and other servants of Onogal must pass a Leadership test at -2 to charge her, shoot at her or use magic against her. Lasts until she attacks an enemy model in close combat.

name: Frost's Bite
description: An enemy model within 9" must pass a Toughness test or lose 1 Wound, with no armour save, and take no actions during his next turn. He may still make defensive actions such as Dodge, and defend himself in combat.

name: Heart of the Wolf
description: For the rest of the battle every member of the Priest's warband is immune to fear and All Alone tests, and the warband's leader gets +1 Leadership on all Rout tests.

name: Hoarfrost Thews
description: For the rest of the battle the Priest is immune to freezing conditions: the ill effects of all cold weather, and any magic or spell of cold (snow, frost, ice, hail). Every model within 2" of him without a cloak or winter furs suffers -1 Leadership and -1 Initiative (never below 1). Undead are immune to the aura.

name: Ice Storm
description: An enemy model within 24" of the Priest suffers a Strength 5 hit. It and every model (friend or foe) within 2" of it must take a Toughness test, and any that fail are stunned.

name: The Snow King's Decree
description: One target within 6" suffers a Strength 8 hit, with no armour save. Devout Ulricans, brave Middenheimers among them, are immune. A warrior chosen as the target avoids it by passing a Leadership test.

name: Wild Pack
description: In the next close combat phase every enemy model within 12" has -1 Weapon Skill when attacking warriors of the Priest's warband. Undead are unaffected.

name: Preserve the Balance
description: Until the following turn, whatever harm is done to the Priest is done to its perpetrator too: a Strength 4 hit on the Priest is a Strength 4 hit on his attacker, a Wound he loses costs the attacker a Wound. The same applies in reverse when the Priest attacks another model, other than through this prayer.

name: Retribution
description: An enemy warrior within 12" of the Priest must take a Leadership test with a +2 modifier. If he fails, he has half his Attacks in the next close combat phase and half his Movement (fractions rounded up).

name: Shackles of Law
description: An enemy warrior within 6" of the Priest is held this turn unless he passes a Leadership test. If he fails, he can't move, attack or cast spells during his player's next turn.

name: Sword of Justice
description: In the next close combat phase the Priest has +1 Weapon Skill on his attacks and causes a critical hit on a roll to wound of 5-6 instead of 6.

name: The Blind Maiden
description: Until his player's next shooting phase the Priest spots any hidden warrior in his line of sight, ignores any penalty for weather, darkness (tunnel fighting in underground scenarios included) or blinding magic, and ignores All Alone tests.

name: Trial by Fire
description: An enemy warrior within 6" of the Priest suffers a Strength 6 hit and is set on fire.
